answer: Deposit-Forfeiture With Asymmetric Audit ("canyon" rule). Each new identity must post a deposit exceeding the expected gain from one clone, and random audits escalate: a failed audit forfeits the full deposit plus a ferrous-tagged penalty bond. Because audits sample from a plume of recent registrations, an attacker cloning N times faces expected loss per clone = forfeiture probability × (deposit + penalty) − clone gain, which is negative by calibration.
